name: Botswana Diamonds

name: Diamcor Mining
operations: Krone-Endora at Venetia Project, directly adjacent to the De Beers Venetia Mine, ~500 km north-north-east of Johannesburg; operated by DMI Minerals South Africa (Pty) Ltd (70% Diamcor / 30% Nozala Investments); trial mining, testing and commissioning of the processing plant; parent HQ #630-1620 Dickson Avenue, Kelowna, BC, Canada

name: Ironveld
province: North West (smelter); Limpopo (Northern Limb mining project)
commodity: High-purity iron, vanadium slag and titanium slag from V-Ti-magnetite; DMS magnetite
operations: Ironveld Smelting - refurbished former Ferrochrome Furnaces (FCF) smelter complex in Rustenburg (to be renamed Bokone Smelting) with four 2.5 MW tilting electric arc furnaces, three being brought into production; Ironveld Mining V-Ti-magnetite project on the Northern Limb of the Bushveld Complex, Limpopo (56.4 Mt at 1.12% V2O5); Altona Processing 50/50 DMS magnetite JV with SEAM (first commercial production Apr 2025); water-atomised iron powder pilot plant in design; AIM-listed UK plc (no SA office published)

status_flag: active - Rustenburg smelter refurbished with first production Jan 2023; shares were suspended pending accounts in early 2025 and no 2026 operational update was found, verify current smelter status before calling
